definition: The use of AI models to analyze source code without executing it, identifying potential bugs, security vulnerabilities, or style issues.
details: AI-assisted static analysis tools extend traditional rule-based static analyzers by using learned models that can catch more nuanced or context-dependent issues in code.
story: Picture a parachute packed by a second pair of hands: nobody plans to need it, but everyone is glad it was checked. The idea is simple: before something powerful is let loose, someone checks that it will not do real harm to real people. It is the habit of asking, before every launch, what could go wrong — and then doing something about it. Caution is not the enemy of progress — it is the reason progress gets to keep going. That deliberate caution is Static Code Analysis (AI-assisted).
